title: Phase 7 Release Checklist
description: Validates non-executing release readiness checks for Phase 7 command-layer work. This schema validates readiness evidence only; it does not execute commands, call providers, mutate runtime state, trigger deployments, approve automatically or bypass human approval.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this release checklist schema contract.

checklistId.description: Deterministic, id-safe identifier for this release checklist.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp for when the release checklist was created.

releaseScope.description: Concise scope of the release readiness check.

schemaValidation.description: Structured check for schema validation readiness.

safetyReview.description: Structured check for safety review completion.

rollbackNotes.description: Structured check for rollback note completeness.

testExpectations.description: Structured check for test expectation coverage.

approvalState.description: Human review approval state for the release checklist.

blockingIssues.description: Issues that may block release readiness.

issueId.description: Stable, id-safe identifier for the blocking issue.

description.description: Reviewable issue description. It must not contain secrets, tokens, provider credentials, executable instructions or local machine paths.

blocksRelease.description: Whether this issue blocks release readiness.

nonExecutableMetadata.description: Review and traceability metadata only. This object must not contain executable instructions, provider credentials, secrets, tokens, deployment actions or local machine paths.

releaseCheck.description: Structured release readiness check with status and notes.

status.description: Status of this release readiness check.

notes.description: Review notes for this check. Notes must not contain secrets, tokens, provider credentials, executable instructions or local machine paths.
